source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. Sailing on a regular passenger ship across an inland sea: carefree lilting 6/8 sea shanty feel, salt breeze and gulls in the imagination, sunlight on waves. Tempo 108 BPM, 6/8 time, key of A major. Instrumentation: harp arpeggios, flute and oboe melody, violin countermelody, accordion color, light tambourine and bass. Form: lilting A section, B section with violin countermelody, back to A. Duration: 70 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
